```{python}
import leafmap
from ipyleaflet import GeoJSON, SearchControl

map = leafmap.Map(
  center=[42.8, -76.0],
  draw_control=False,
  layers_control=True,
  zoom=8
)

locations = GeoJSON(
    data="data/cny_churches_2026.geojson",
    name="Addresses"
)

map.add_marker_cluster(
  "data/cny_churches_2026.geojson",
  x="Longitude",
  y="Latitude",
  popup=["Name",
         "Address_Search",
         "Website"],
  layer_name="CNY Churches" 
)

map.add(
  SearchControl(
    position="topleft",
    layer="data/cny_churches_2026.geojson",
    property_name="Address_Search",
    zoom=15
)
)

map
```
